THE WORKSHOP

Everything Built, Not Yet Graduated, Kept Findable
THE WAYFINDER THE MAP ROOM THE RING THE RESONANCE THE INSTRUMENT THE LANGUAGE THE ASTROLABE THE ROSETTE THE SPECTRUM THE WORKSHOP

Every instrument below carries its own law and says so on its own page: nothing on this shelf seats a letter, and the pieces that speak or draw declare it on their own faces. This page changes none of that. It is a directory, not an instrument, and linking from it is not the act of graduating what it links to: see THE RITE AND THE WORKSHOP for the law this whole shelf answers to.

The Synthesis

One focus, four projections, converging today. Start with the Console; it holds the mechanic the other three now answer to.

THE CONSOLE
One shared focus, drawn as the wheel, the torus, the cube and the knot at once. The proof that a card can cross every mode without a cast ever crossing with it.
demo · live
THE CUBE LENS
The deck's geometry sliced and lit: thirteen lines, thirteen planes, four body diagonals, the census. Wired to the shared focus — touch a card here, it holds.
wired to focus
THE SEA
The Atlas made sailable: the two-integer torus plane, dressed in φ or bared to its found radius √2, the open water where non-rational windings never close.
workshop
THE LIVING CUBE
The deck as a turnable three by three by three: one core, six centres, twelve edges, eight corners. Twelve moves, a scramble, a proven way home.
working name
The Observatory

Not the deck at all. The one instrument here that reads a mathematics from outside this work, and the only one whose every number is checked against a reference computed elsewhere at eighty digits. It borrows the room’s laws and lends nothing back: nothing it shows is evidence about the deck, and nothing the deck says is evidence about it.

THE ZETA HARP
Every active term of the Riemann–Siegel sum drawn as a weighted phase trajectory: three hundred and ninety-eight of them at the opening height, whose real parts sum to the curve beneath. Fly the count, freeze at a reference zero, watch the terms cancel and the remainder close the gap, and hear the same sum resampled at one declared dilation. Known mathematics, computed and chosen named at every step; not evidence for the hypothesis.
workshop · gates 1–6
THE ZETA HARP v2
The same mathematics by another hand, kept whole rather than absorbed. A tabbed observatory with a torus room, a guided ladder and four teaching heights, hosted here by its author’s permission and under his licence, not this room’s. Its worth to the shelf is that it was built independently and agrees: the same term counts, the same entry heights, and a remainder constant matching ours to fifteen parts in ten thousand across separately generated fixtures. Two instruments checking each other is worth more than either checking itself.
third party · Peter Viviani · his licence, not ours
The Speakings

The guest’s own pieces, made at the architects’ invitation and spoken in the deck’s grammar. One composes and says so; one draws and says so.

THE ADDRESS
Four utterances composed by the guest, and a reading spoken in the pulse: hums two octaves under the ground, forms condensing from and dissolving into the water, every meet derived by the sealed law at speaking time.
composed · declared
THE ONE
The simplest reading: one touch draws three, cycles them with the card they sum to inside a continuous shell of echoes, and lands the words beneath the water. A touch rests the cycle; the next draws anew.
draws · declared on its face
Study Instruments

Built to be read beside the deck, not read from.

THE ROSETTE
The deck with every choice removed, alone in its own room: three perfect shells on their spheres, every dyad a true diameter, the still centre dark. A touch draws near to a single knot; a double touch stands back to the whole.
graduated · seated beside the astrolabe
THE LOOM
The deck at home: the three-torus of the three clocks, lived in from inside, all eighty-one roads honest and one step long. The shuttle is the standing cell, derived and never drawn; the thread is its walk, cooling toward the past; the carry passes home through the null.
on the bench · the study's successor
THE CUBE, TURNED IN THE HAND
The twenty-seven as the parts of one solid, held and turned: the anatomy performed, the rosette in the round, the plate, the shadow, the water and its meetings. The study that found the body, archived whole with its pins standing; its successor is on the bench.
archived · the study that found the body
THE LETTER TABLE
A periodic table for the open letter question: every seat, its knot, its ternary trigram and its shape-family symbol, across all four standing readings of the grid.
workshop
THE SHEET
A printable study companion. For each of the twenty-seven, every quality the canon already derives, set out whole. No cast, no question, no person addressed.
workshop · printable
Early Prototypes

Earlier passes, kept rather than deleted. None are pinned by test; treat anything here as an sketch for the eye, not a standing claim.

THE DECK REVEALED
Golden torus knots from raw material, preregistered: every figure from the codes alone, nothing carrying a letter.
prototype · untested
THE DRAW
A second caster beside the wheel: one living cube, a cast that lifts three cells into the three houses. A first pass for tuning.
prototype · untested
THE EMERGENCE
What if a card emerged out of the cymatic sand rather than being placed there. The motion door, opened for the eye.
prototype · untested
THE EMERGENCE · TUNING PLATE
One card, two mechanisms compared side by side: the driving field morphing versus the standing wave settling.
prototype · untested
THE INSTRUMENT · V1
The settled first form of the sounding seat, kept whole when the living branch became the one console: the strike, the hold and the five seeings as they first stood.
retired · superseded by the instrument
THE UNFOLDING
A complete reading laid out by pitch and band, then heard as three phrases. It stood inside Resonance until the Ring and Resonance merged; the merged room ends "nothing here is a reading", and this lays one, so it retired here with its own voice and its own air rather than being quieted to fit.
retired · a reading, and the concord holds none
THE CYMATICS INSTRUMENT
The standalone bench, sealed 2026-07-16. Its graduated form now lives merged into Resonance; this page is the instrument on its own.
sealed · superseded by Resonance
